subject: Acme Supplies — Vendor master data corrections & onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acme-supplies.com>, vendor-admin@acme-supplies.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Supplies — vendor onboarding kickoff and data checklist

Hi Emily —

Thanks for confirming the account setup window. We're kicking off vendor onboarding for Acme Supplies today. To keep things tidy on both sides, I put together a short checklist we need completed before we issue the first PO:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Signed W-9 (if US entity)
- Bank details for ACH (bank_update_form.xlsx attached)
- Confirmation of legal remit address and tax jurisdiction
- Any existing Redwood vendor ID(s) to avoid duplicates

Two small items we already flagged on our side: your initial record showed a San Jose HQ address but your billing remit should be the Newark office — can you confirm which address to use? Also, if you've worked with Redwood previously under another supplier name, please share the alternate name so we can dedupe.

Next steps: please return the filled onboarding form and the W-9 by EOD Thu (Mar 12). Marissa on our procurement team will validate the banking info and run the vendor master updates; Dev will create the initial PO template once the vendor is active.

CC'd are Dev (procurement ops) and Marissa (vendor master). Rishi from finance will be looped in for final banking verification if needed.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf (form, 3 pages)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acme-supplies.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vendor-admin@acme-supplies.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Acme Supplies — vendor onboarding kickoff and data checklist

Hi Laura —

Thanks — received. A couple of quick clarifications:

1) Remit address: The correct remit/billing address is:
   Acme Supplies Inc.
   Accounts Receivable
   420 Industrial Way
   Newark, NJ 07102

   The San Jose location is our R&D office and should not be used for invoices.

2) Duplicate record: We did an integration with a marketplace in 2024 and the vendor name was entered there as "Acme Supply Co." — we believe Redwood created a second record when we submitted via the marketplace.

3) Banking: I attached the completed bank_update_form.xlsx with the ACH routing and account (last 4 digits 9821) and a copy of our signed W-9. We redact full account numbers on email for safety; vendor-admin will push the full bank docs through your secure upload link (DocuSign/Portal).

I uploaded the completed onboarding form and the signed W-9 via your secure link (see DocuSign confirmation: https://docusign.com/rec/placeholder-id-ACME-2026).

Let me know if you need an official contact or PO instructions for cross-border shipments — our export team handles those.

Best,
Emily
Vendor Operations Manager
Acme Supplies

Attachments: W9_Acme_Supplies_signed.pdf, bank_update_form.xlsx (contact sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Jones <emily.jones@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Acme Supplies — vendor onboarding kickoff and data checklist

Thanks Emily —

Quick update from procurement review:
- Received onboarding form and W-9 (confirmed).
- Noted the duplicate name "Acme Supply Co." — Dev, can you check our vendor master for two records and flag which one has prior payments? We need to merge rather than create a new active vendor.
- Bank update: Rishi, will you accept an encrypted upload from vendor-admin to validate the routing/account? Once finance confirms, we'll update the vendor master and set the ACH terms.

I will hold creating a live vendor record until we confirm the correct remit address and merge decision. If we do need to merge, timeline is ~1 business day once finance approves banking.

Emily — if you can forward any vendor IDs or invoice examples from the marketplace entry that would help speed dedupe.

Thanks —
Marissa
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Jones <emily.jones@acme-supplies.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acme Supplies — vendor onboarding kickoff and data checklist

Hi all —

I received the encrypted upload from vendor-admin and validated the bank routing + account owner name (matched W-9). Routing ends with 0710 and account last 4 digits 9821 as referenced — good to proceed with ACH.

Marissa/Dev: I recommend we merge the two vendor records under the primary vendor ID 110-ACME-2024 (the marketplace-created record) and mark the marketplace alias as "historical". I'll record the bank change in GL vendor file and attach the verification note.

Please see my internal note: https://redwoodinference.app/drive/shared/Acme-Onboarding-Checklist (bank verification doc).

Once merged and the remit address is updated to the Newark address provided, procurement can create PO RED-PO-2026-0042 and route it to Acme Supplies.

Rishi
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: finance_bank_validation_note.txt (internal)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:28:00 -07:00

All —

Merged vendor records under ID 110-ACME-2024 and updated remit address to:
Acme Supplies Inc.
Accounts Receivable
420 Industrial Way
Newark, NJ 07102

Laura — closing this loop on the onboarding checklist. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
